# SteelStud.ca

> steelstud.ca - Vancouver's Premier Steel Stud Framing & General Contracting. 16 years steel stud expertise, 35 years general contracting.

SteelStud.ca specializes in condominium renovations, tenant improvements, commercial buildouts, drywall, T-bar ceilings and steel stud framing across Metro Vancouver BC.

## Services

- Steel Stud Framing
- Drywall Boarding & Finishing
- T-Bar & Suspended Ceilings
- Tenant Improvements
- Condominium Renovations
- Commercial Buildouts
- Wood Framing
- Architectural Steel

## Service Area

Metro Vancouver: Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Richmond, Coquitlam, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Langley, Abbotsford, New Westminster, Delta, White Rock, Maple Ridge, Port Coquitlam, Chilliwack
